title: TopoEdit-Off: a source-aware benchmark and validation-priority framework for high-mismatch genome-editing off-target candidates
description: TopoEdit-Off provides a source-aware benchmark and validation-priority framework for high-mismatch genome-editing off-target candidates. This GitHub package includes small publication-facing resource tables, validation-panel resources, benchmark summaries, role/claim locks, manifests, checksums, and a minimal reproducibility demo. It is not a calibrated off-target probability predictor.

creators.name: Park, Jaejun
creators.affiliation: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences, KAIST

notes: This software/resource release accompanies a computational benchmark manuscript. It does not claim calibrated off-target probability.
